messages:
Sophie: Quick Q  saved-view preview: if someone saves a route view with an existing pinned model, should restore lock the pin or only suggest it? Need decision for Friday rollout.

Jamal: Lock by default. Saved view should capture exact state. API: add pinned_models + preview.locked (default false when missing).

Maria Chen: Lock + show telemetry in preview: sample_rate, 24h_token_burn, estimated token delta if model differs. Helps cost decisions.

Oliver: UI: keep it compact - [ModelChip] [delta badge] [info]. Info flyout shows sample rate, burn, provenance.

Kevin (PM): Migration risk for existing savedviews. Gate behind feature flag `console.savedview.v2` and show opt-in banner for affected users.

Sophie: Plan: RFC for default-lock, preview fields (sample_rate, token_estimate, provenance), FF, migration UX. Action items: Jamal API + migration script, Oliver chip + flyout, Maria telemetry endpoints, Kevin rollout comms.
